# `window_kind`

A kind of reaction window: how soon and whether it is noticed, and how far its offer reaches (03 §7.1).

Defaults that `scale` and `add` act on when a definition leaves the field out (04 §6.1): `notice` 0, `reach` 0.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `notice` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions); default `0`): How long the candidate takes to notice: seconds of the candidate's own local time. Left out, it is zero: noticed the moment the window opens.
- `noticed_if` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): Whether the candidate can notice at all. Left out, it always can.
- `reach` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; default `0`): How far, in metres, from the source or from someone the window names, a candidate the window does not name may be: one who holds an `intervenes` relation toward someone it names, or a directly controlled character. Left out, it is zero.
